scope: Local actual GLB rendering using Chromium SwiftShader at DPR1; synthetic desktop/browser evidence, not physical phone GPU performance.

metrics.scope: Every delivered athlete and required clip sampled at at least120Hz. Actual skinned-mesh bounding boxes are recomputed from deformed vertices after world-matrix updates. End-to-start compares world bones at0 and duration minus1microsecond; one-shot recovery differences are reported, not called loop failures.

Synchronous CPU time for setTime (animation sampling and one render submission); 100 samples after 20 warmup calls. Software rendering in Chromium; excludes display refresh and asynchronous GPU completion.
